parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time when the policy takes effect. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time when the policy takes effect. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description:
The policy template. Valid values:
- **promotion**: Important Activity template.
- **bypass**: full forwarding.
